name: interface-craft-cards
title: Interface Craft Cards
description: Five coloured cards lie in a loose tilted fan. Clicking one straightens it, scales it up and brings it to the middle with a short description, while the others shrink and drop away; a click outside restores the fan.
use: A few peer options or topics should be browsable as a playful stack instead of a plain list.
avoid: Overlapping cards cut off their own titles, and the wide fan needs a large centred area to sit in.
a11y: Cards are buttons and can be tabbed to, but there is no focus ring, no Escape to close, and reduced-motion is never checked. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five tall rounded cards in orange, off-white, blue, purple and near-black, spread in a shallow overlapping fan on black. Each has a soft gradient block across the top and a white title near its lower edge; the chosen card sits upright and larger with a paragraph beneath its title.
behaves: At rest the cards lean at small angles with staggered heights. Clicking a card rotates it upright, enlarges it and slides it to centre while the rest scale down and fall behind; clicking anywhere outside springs everything back to the fan.
customise: Spring feel, active scale and card spacing are props; the five cards, their titles, descriptions and colours are written into the array.
weight: light: Five cards using spring and layout transforms that only run during a change.
demo: Five competency cards: Working Knowledge, Practical Demonstration, Collaborate with AI, Means & Methods, Interface Kit.
issues: In the fanned state the overlapping cards clip each other's titles.
There is no visible focus ring and no Escape key to dismiss the open card.
polishWhy: Bold colours and a satisfying springy reveal; clipped titles and missing focus cues cost it.
